_recorded_from: synthetic boundary cases (hand-written expectations) + one live case RECORDED from production via src/scripts/accuracy-report.ts --emit-fixture
_note: Shared by sidelineiq-agents (src/utils/accuracy-observations.ts) and sidelineiq-frontend (lib/accuracy-observations.ts). The two implementations are byte-identical and this file is what stops them drifting: copy it to both repos together. helper_version must equal ACCURACY_OBSERVATIONS_VERSION in both. The live case is the corpus BEFORE the 2026-10 physician re-score (two legacy records still present).

cases.name: Burns shape: one return on two threads, both misses, counts once
disagreeing duplicates: the earliest-opened thread is the verdict
disagreeing duplicates, open order reversed: the verdict follows the earliest-opened
earliest-opened member unscoreable: the earliest SCOREABLE member is the verdict
Pierce shape: four unscoreable threads on one return are one exclusion
same player, different return dates: two returns
different players, same return date: two returns
a timestamped return date groups with a plain one
legacy record (no scoreable key) is derived from within_range and flagged
VOID and ACTIVE are not the population; RETIRED with no return is excluded; no record is excluded
a scored record with a null error still counts for the headline but not the secondary n
out of scope: a PREMIER_LEAGUE close is not counted; a row with no sport is kept
